explanation: The price of Electronics in the South region was drastically reduced from 100.0 to 50.0 starting on 2026-08-15. This 50% price cut for a high-value product significantly reduced the revenue generated by this segment (estimated loss of 47,800 for the period 2026-08-16 to 2026-08-31 alone), which is greater than the overall revenue decline experienced across all segments after 2026-08-15. No other metrics (visitors, conversion rate, inventory) show a comparable negative change that would explain the overall drop.
